import json
import re

# ============================================================
# READ AI NODE OUTPUT
# ============================================================

raw_ai = r'''$Generate_AI_Recommended_Actions.message'''

try:
    data = json.loads(raw_ai)
except Exception:
    data = {}

if isinstance(data, dict) and isinstance(data.get("message"), dict):
    data = data["message"]

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

def parse_json_if_string(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        try:
            return json.loads(value)
        except Exception:
            return value
    return value


def as_dict(value):
    value = parse_json_if_string(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    return {}


def clean(value, default="Unknown"):
    if value in [None, "", "null", "None", [], {}]:
        return default
    return str(value)


def is_known(value):
    value = clean(value, "")
    return value not in ["", "Unknown", "unknown", "N/A", "n/a", "null", "None"]


def add_line(lines, label, value):
    if is_known(value):
        lines.append(f"• {label}: {value}")


def clean_list(value):
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        if is_known(value):
            return [str(value)]
        return []

    return [str(x) for x in value if is_known(x)]


def add_list_line(lines, label, value):
    items = clean_list(value)
    if items:
        lines.append(f"• {label}: {', '.join(items)}")


def section_has_content(start_index, lines):
    """
    Returns True if a section has at least one bullet after its heading.
    """
    for line in lines[start_index + 1:]:
        if line.strip() == "":
            break
        if line.startswith("• "):
            return True
    return False


def remove_empty_sections(lines):
    """
    Removes headings that have no bullets under them.
    """
    result = []
    i = 0

    section_headings = [
        "🔎 Scan / Recon Observables",
        "🧬 Malware / Endpoint Observables",
        "🌐 Related Network Observables",
        "🌐 C2 / Beaconing Observables",
        "💻 Endpoint Context",
        "🔐 Authentication Observables",
        "🌍 Web Attack Observables",
        "🔎 Key Observables",
        "🧪 VirusTotal",
        "🚨 Alert Metadata"
    ]

    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i]

        if line in section_headings:
            temp = [line]
            j = i + 1

            while j < len(lines):
                temp.append(lines[j])
                if lines[j].strip() == "":
                    break
                j += 1

            has_bullet = any(x.startswith("• ") for x in temp)

            if has_bullet:
                result.extend(temp)

            i = j + 1
        else:
            result.append(line)
            i += 1

    # Remove too many blank lines
    text = "\n".join(result)
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text).strip()
    return text.split("\n")


# ============================================================
# FIELDS FROM AI NODE
# ============================================================

ai_status = clean(data.get("ai_status"))
ai_error = clean(data.get("ai_error"), "")
ai_model = clean(data.get("ai_model"))

alert_type = clean(data.get("alert_type"), "generic").lower()
if alert_type not in ["scan", "malware", "c2", "auth", "web_attack", "network", "generic"]:
    alert_type = "generic"

case_id = clean(data.get("case_id"))
severity = clean(data.get("severity"))
score = clean(data.get("score"))
thehive_severity = data.get("thehive_severity", 2)

agent = clean(data.get("agent"))
agent_id = clean(data.get("agent_id"))
agent_ip = clean(data.get("agent_ip"))

rule_id = clean(data.get("rule_id"))
rule_desc = clean(data.get("rule_desc"))
rule_groups = data.get("rule_groups", [])
level = clean(data.get("level"))

mitre_ids = data.get("mitre_ids", [])
mitre_tactics = data.get("mitre_tactics", [])
mitre_techniques = data.get("mitre_techniques", [])

srcip = clean(data.get("srcip"))
dstip = clean(data.get("dstip"))
srcport = clean(data.get("srcport"))
dstport = clean(data.get("dstport"))
protocol = clean(data.get("protocol"))
action = clean(data.get("action"))

domain = clean(data.get("domain"))
url = clean(data.get("url"))
dns_query = clean(data.get("dns_query"))
http_method = clean(data.get("http_method"))
http_status = clean(data.get("http_status"))

file_name = clean(data.get("file_name"))
file_path = clean(data.get("file_path"))
file_hash = clean(data.get("file_hash"))
md5 = clean(data.get("md5"))
sha1 = clean(data.get("sha1"))
sha256 = clean(data.get("sha256"))
process_name = clean(data.get("process_name"))
parent_process = clean(data.get("parent_process"))
command_line = clean(data.get("command_line"))
username = clean(data.get("username"))

alert_id = clean(data.get("alert_id"))
source = clean(data.get("source"))
location = clean(data.get("location"))
manager = clean(data.get("manager"))
full_log = clean(data.get("full_log"), "")

vt_enabled = clean(data.get("vt_enabled"))
vt_malicious = clean(data.get("vt_malicious"))
vt_suspicious = clean(data.get("vt_suspicious"))
vt_harmless = clean(data.get("vt_harmless"))
vt_undetected = clean(data.get("vt_undetected"))

telegram_message = clean(data.get("telegram_message"), "")
ai_recommended_actions = clean(data.get("ai_recommended_actions") or data.get("recommended_actions"), "")

if not ai_recommended_actions.startswith("🛠️ Recommended Analyst Actions"):
    ai_recommended_actions = "🛠️ Recommended Analyst Actions\n\n" + ai_recommended_actions

email_subject = clean(
    data.get("email_subject"),
    f"[SOCaaS][{severity}][{alert_type}] Rule {rule_id} - {agent}"
)

old_mailtrap_payload = as_dict(data.get("mailtrap_payload_json", "{}"))
old_thehive_payload = as_dict(data.get("thehive_case_payload_json", "{}"))

# ============================================================
# BUILD CONTEXT-AWARE BODY
# ============================================================

if severity == "CRITICAL":
    icon = "🔥"
elif severity == "HIGH":
    icon = "🚨"
elif severity == "MEDIUM":
    icon = "⚠️"
else:
    icon = "ℹ️"

lines = []

lines.append(f"{icon} SOCaaS Security Alert")
lines.append("")

# -------------------------
# Case
# -------------------------
lines.append("🆔 Case")
add_line(lines, "Case ID", case_id)
add_line(lines, "Severity", severity)
add_line(lines, "SOC Score", score)
add_line(lines, "Alert Type", alert_type)
lines.append("")

# -------------------------
# Agent
# -------------------------
lines.append("💻 Agent")
add_line(lines, "Name", agent)
add_line(lines, "IP", agent_ip)
add_line(lines, "ID", agent_id)
lines.append("")

# -------------------------
# Rule
# -------------------------
lines.append("📜 Rule")
add_line(lines, "ID", rule_id)
add_line(lines, "Wazuh Level", level)
add_line(lines, "Description", rule_desc)
add_list_line(lines, "Groups", rule_groups)
add_list_line(lines, "MITRE IDs", mitre_ids)
add_list_line(lines, "MITRE Tactics", mitre_tactics)
add_list_line(lines, "MITRE Techniques", mitre_techniques)
lines.append("")

# ============================================================
# TYPE-SPECIFIC SECTIONS
# ============================================================

if alert_type == "scan":
    lines.append("🔎 Scan / Recon Observables")
    add_line(lines, "Source IP", srcip)
    add_line(lines, "Target IP", dstip)
    add_line(lines, "Source Port", srcport)
    add_line(lines, "Target Port", dstport)
    add_line(lines, "Protocol", protocol)
    add_line(lines, "Firewall Action", action)
    lines.append("")

elif alert_type == "malware":
    lines.append("🧬 Malware / Endpoint Observables")
    add_line(lines, "File Name", file_name)
    add_line(lines, "File Path", file_path)
    add_line(lines, "File Hash", file_hash)
    add_line(lines, "MD5", md5)
    add_line(lines, "SHA1", sha1)
    add_line(lines, "SHA256", sha256)
    add_line(lines, "Process Name", process_name)
    add_line(lines, "Parent Process", parent_process)
    add_line(lines, "Command Line", command_line)
    add_line(lines, "Username", username)
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("🌐 Related Network Observables")
    add_line(lines, "Source IP", srcip)
    add_line(lines, "Destination IP", dstip)
    add_line(lines, "Destination Port", dstport)
    add_line(lines, "Protocol", protocol)
    add_line(lines, "Domain", domain)
    add_line(lines, "URL", url)
    add_line(lines, "DNS Query", dns_query)
    lines.append("")

elif alert_type == "c2":
    lines.append("🌐 C2 / Beaconing Observables")
    add_line(lines, "Source IP", srcip)
    add_line(lines, "Destination IP", dstip)
    add_line(lines, "Destination Port", dstport)
    add_line(lines, "Protocol", protocol)
    add_line(lines, "Domain", domain)
    add_line(lines, "URL", url)
    add_line(lines, "DNS Query", dns_query)
    add_line(lines, "Action", action)
    lines.append("")

    lines.append("💻 Endpoint Context")
    add_line(lines, "Process Name", process_name)
    add_line(lines, "Parent Process", parent_process)
    add_line(lines, "Command Line", command_line)
    add_line(lines, "Username", username)
    lines.append("")

elif alert_type == "auth":
    lines.append("🔐 Authentication Observables")
    add_line(lines, "Source IP", srcip)
    add_line(lines, "Target IP", dstip)
    add_line(lines, "Username", username)
    add_line(lines, "Action", action)
    add_line(lines, "Protocol", protocol)
    add_line(lines, "Destination Port", dstport)
    lines.append("")

elif alert_type == "web_attack":
    lines.append("🌍 Web Attack Observables")
    add_line(lines, "Source IP", srcip)
    add_line(lines, "Destination IP", dstip)
    add_line(lines, "Domain", domain)
    add_line(lines, "URL", url)
    add_line(lines, "HTTP Method", http_method)
    add_line(lines, "HTTP Status", http_status)
    add_line(lines, "Action", action)
    lines.append("")

else:
    lines.append("🔎 Key Observables")
    add_line(lines, "Source IP", srcip)
    add_line(lines, "Destination IP", dstip)
    add_line(lines, "Source Port", srcport)
    add_line(lines, "Destination Port", dstport)
    add_line(lines, "Protocol", protocol)
    add_line(lines, "Action", action)
    add_line(lines, "Domain", domain)
    add_line(lines, "URL", url)
    add_line(lines, "DNS Query", dns_query)
    add_line(lines, "File Hash", file_hash)
    add_line(lines, "Process Name", process_name)
    add_line(lines, "Username", username)
    lines.append("")

# ============================================================
# VIRUSTOTAL SECTION
# ============================================================

if str(vt_enabled).lower() == "true":
    lines.append("🧪 VirusTotal")
    add_line(lines, "Malicious", vt_malicious)
    add_line(lines, "Suspicious", vt_suspicious)

    if is_known(vt_harmless) and str(vt_harmless) != "0":
        add_line(lines, "Harmless", vt_harmless)

    if is_known(vt_undetected) and str(vt_undetected) != "0":
        add_line(lines, "Undetected", vt_undetected)

    lines.append("")

# ============================================================
# ALERT METADATA
# ============================================================

lines.append("🚨 Alert Metadata")
add_line(lines, "Alert ID", alert_id)
add_line(lines, "Source", source)
add_line(lines, "Location", location)
add_line(lines, "Manager", manager)
lines.append("")

# ============================================================
# RAW LOG
# ============================================================

if is_known(full_log):
    lines.append("🧾 Raw Log")
    lines.append(full_log)
    lines.append("")

# ============================================================
# AI RECOMMENDED ACTIONS
# ============================================================

lines.append(ai_recommended_actions.strip())
lines.append("")

# ============================================================
# PIPELINE
# ============================================================

lines.append("🔁 Pipeline")
lines.append("Wazuh → Pipeline Gateway → VirusTotal → Shuffle → Telegram/Email → TheHive")

lines = remove_empty_sections(lines)
email_body = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", "\n".join(lines)).strip()

# ============================================================
# UPDATE MAILTRAP PAYLOAD
# ============================================================

mailtrap_payload = old_mailtrap_payload

if not mailtrap_payload:
    mailtrap_payload = {
        "from": {
            "email": "hello@demomailtrap.co",
            "name": "SOCaaS Lab"
        },
        "to": [
            {
                "email": "khalil.hamidani@univ-alger.dz",
                "name": "Khalil Hamidani"
            }
        ],
        "subject": email_subject,
        "text": email_body,
        "category": "SOCaaS Alert"
    }
else:
    mailtrap_payload["subject"] = email_subject
    mailtrap_payload["text"] = email_body

# ============================================================
# UPDATE THEHIVE PAYLOAD
# ============================================================

try:
    thehive_severity_int = int(thehive_severity)
except Exception:
    thehive_severity_int = 2

thehive_payload = old_thehive_payload

if not thehive_payload:
    thehive_payload = {
        "title": f"[SOCaaS][{severity}][{alert_type}] Rule {rule_id} - {agent}",
        "description": email_body,
        "severity": thehive_severity_int,
        "tlp": 2,
        "pap": 2,
        "tags": [],
        "flag": False
    }
else:
    thehive_payload["description"] = email_body
    thehive_payload["severity"] = thehive_severity_int

# Improve title
thehive_payload["title"] = f"[SOCaaS][{severity}][{alert_type}] Rule {rule_id} - {agent}"

tags = thehive_payload.get("tags", [])
if not isinstance(tags, list):
    tags = []

extra_tags = [
    "socaas",
    "shuffle",
    "wazuh",
    severity.lower(),
    f"alert-type-{alert_type}",
    "ai-recommended-actions"
]

if ai_status == "success":
    extra_tags.append("ai-success")
else:
    extra_tags.append("ai-failed")

if is_known(srcip):
    extra_tags.append("srcip-" + re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+", "-", srcip)[:80])

if is_known(dstip):
    extra_tags.append("dstip-" + re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+", "-", dstip)[:80])

if is_known(dstport):
    extra_tags.append("dpt-" + re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+", "-", dstport)[:80])

if is_known(domain):
    extra_tags.append("ioc-domain")

if is_known(url):
    extra_tags.append("ioc-url")

if is_known(dns_query):
    extra_tags.append("ioc-dns")

if is_known(file_hash) or is_known(md5) or is_known(sha1) or is_known(sha256):
    extra_tags.append("ioc-file-hash")

if is_known(process_name):
    extra_tags.append("endpoint-process")

if is_known(username):
    extra_tags.append("user-context")

for tag in extra_tags:
    if tag not in tags:
        tags.append(tag)

thehive_payload["tags"] = tags

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT
# ============================================================

output = {
    "status": "ready",

    "case_id": case_id,
    "severity": severity,
    "score": score,
    "alert_type": alert_type,
    "thehive_severity": thehive_severity_int,

    "agent": agent,
    "agent_id": agent_id,
    "agent_ip": agent_ip,

    "rule_id": rule_id,
    "rule_desc": rule_desc,
    "rule_groups": rule_groups,
    "level": level,

    "srcip": srcip,
    "dstip": dstip,
    "srcport": srcport,
    "dstport": dstport,
    "protocol": protocol,
    "action": action,

    "domain": domain,
    "url": url,
    "dns_query": dns_query,
    "http_method": http_method,
    "http_status": http_status,

    "file_name": file_name,
    "file_path": file_path,
    "file_hash": file_hash,
    "md5": md5,
    "sha1": sha1,
    "sha256": sha256,
    "process_name": process_name,
    "parent_process": parent_process,
    "command_line": command_line,
    "username": username,

    "alert_id": alert_id,
    "source": source,
    "location": location,
    "manager": manager,
    "full_log": full_log,

    "ai_status": ai_status,
    "ai_error": ai_error,
    "ai_model": ai_model,
    "ai_recommended_actions": ai_recommended_actions,

    "telegram_message": telegram_message,
    "email_subject": email_subject,
    "email_body": email_body,

    "mailtrap_payload_json": json.dumps(mailtrap_payload),
    "thehive_case_payload_json": json.dumps(thehive_payload)
}

print(json.dumps(output))
